---
title: "carrier.toml"
---

`carrier.toml` sits at the root of a module project, one level above the source directory. It has up to four tables: `[module]` (required), `[package_deps]`, `[module_deps]`, and `[test]`.

## `[module]`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Also the default source directory name. |
| `version` | string | yes | Free-form; `carrier bundle` uses it verbatim in the output filename. |
| `description` | string | yes | May be empty. |
| `authors` | array | yes | See [Authors](#authors) below. |
| `license` | string | yes | |
| `r_version` | string | yes | Declarative minimum R version. See the note in [Known Gaps](../internals/known-gaps.qmd) — nothing currently checks this against the running R installation. |
| `src` | string | no | Path to the source directory, relative to the project root. Defaults to a directory named exactly `name`. Whatever directory is used, it must contain `__init__.R`. |

### Authors

Each entry in `authors` is either a plain string or an inline table:

``` toml
authors = [
    "Jane Doe",
    { name = "Joshua Marie", email = "joshua.marie.k@gmail.com" },
]
```

The inline table form accepts `name` (required), and optional `email`, `url`, `orcid`.

## `[package_deps]`

Maps an R package name to a version requirement — either a bare string (CRAN, default mirror) or an inline table with an explicit `repo`:

``` toml
[package_deps]
dplyr = "*"
ggplot2 = ">=3.4.0"
fable = { version = "*", repo = "https://tidyverts.r-universe.dev/" }
```

### Version spec syntax

| Syntax | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"*"` | Any version |
| `">=1.0.0"` | Lower bound only |
| `">=1.0.0, <2.0.0"` | Range (comma-separated bounds) |
| `"^1.2.0"` | semver-compatible with 1.2.0 |
| `"=1.2.3"` | Exact pin |

R version strings that use dashes (e.g. `4.0-3`, as CRAN's `PACKAGES` index does) are normalized to dots internally before being parsed as semver.

## `[module_deps]`

Maps a `carrier`-installed module name to a version requirement string, using the same syntax as `[package_deps]`:

``` toml
[module_deps]
other_module = "*"
```

Transitive resolution for module dependencies is not yet implemented — see [Known Gaps](../internals/known-gaps.qmd).

## `[test]`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `framework` | string | yes | e.g. `"testthat"` |
| `dir` | string | no | Test directory, e.g. `"tests"` |

## Full template

This is what `carrier init` writes:

``` toml
[module]
name = "convert"
version = "0.1.0"
description = ""
authors = [
    { name = "Your Name", email = "you@example.com" },
]
license = "Unknown"
r_version = "4.0.0"
# src = "convert"    # path to the source directory containing __init__.R
                      # defaults to a directory named after the module

[package_deps]
# dplyr = "*"
# ggplot2 = ">=3.4.0"
# fable = { version = "*", repo = "https://tidyverts.r-universe.dev/" }

[module_deps]
# other_module = "*"

[test]
framework = "testthat"
dir = "tests"
```
